notes: Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 21 June 2001, before Coruscant, and the list has no Coruscant-set card.

Starting cards as posted under START (9): Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place, Death Star II: Docking Bay, Death Star II: Throne Room, Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, Crush The Rebellion; they count toward the 60. Several Effects start, and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is shown as one.
The objective was posted over two lines ('Bring Him Before Me/Take Your' / 'Father's Place'); it is one card.
Posted 'Mobilization Point' dested Mobilization Points (Death Star II): the strategy uses its text to take Carida into hand before activating, not the You Cannot Hide Forever combo.
Posted 'Endor DB' dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark) and 'Tatooine DB' dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Dark) (the deck's side).

Posted 'Emperor Palpitine' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'Darth Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); '4-LOM w/ Gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'IG-88 w/ Gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Dr. Evazan & Ponda Boba' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Bossk in Bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Zuckuss in Ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.
Posted 'Vaders LightSaber', 'Mauls LightSaber', 'Mara's LightSaber' dested Vader's Lightsaber, Maul's Lightsaber, Mara Jade's Lightsaber.
Secret Plans and No Escape are 2001 Effects (not Defensive Shields).
